background.value: Plain, light-colored (light blue or light gray acceptable); white background is PROHIBITED

head_height.value: 32-36 mm (chin to top of skull, excluding hair); face must occupy 70-80% of photo

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and looking directly at camera

glasses_policy.value: Glasses optional; if worn, frames cannot be thick or hide eyes, lenses must not be tinted or produce glare

face_visibility.value: Face must be clear and fully visible; eyes perfectly visible and open; hair must not cover face (bangs acceptable if they do not obstruct eyes)

headwear_policy.value: Head must be bare; no hats, scarves, or headbands

accessories.value: Earrings and piercings permitted if they do not obscure facial features
